blocking.finding: Under a degraded parked read _is_parked_anchor is True for every anchor, so the drain falls through to resume_pending.pop(0) and permanently deletes the queued dev_resume_pending entry and its resume_branch on a transient gh failure.
blocking.fix: On a degraded read skip the drain without popping; drop an entry only when positively parked on a healthy read; test that dev_resume_pending is unchanged after a degraded turn.

blocking.finding: The parked filter only changes the local head; the dispatch carries only scope=orch and hydra-qa self-selects its own unfiltered .[0], so with needs-qa=[parked, unparked] the parked head can still be reviewed (round-1 finding 1 only partly fixed).
blocking.fix: Pin the filtered head in prompt_args and honour it in hydra-qa, or exclude parked in hydra-qa's query; add a mixed-list test.

blocking.finding: Round-1 finding 1 only partly fixed: filtered head is not passed to hydra-qa, which self-selects the unfiltered .[0].
blocking.fix: Pin the chosen issue in prompt_args and honour it in the skill; mixed-list test.

blocking.finding: INV-4 fail-closed on a degraded parked read only runs inside 'if numbers:'; absent/empty needs_qa_numbers dispatches qa_orch while orch_parked_unreadable is true.
blocking.fix: Check _parked_read_degraded before the if-numbers branch; add test.

blocking.finding: ALL_DEGRADED_SIGNALS sets orch_parked_unreadable false, so on an all-degraded marker turn the belt fails open for dev_resume_pending and in-session qa-verdict events, contradicting INV-4 and prGateFallbackSnapshot (which emits unreadable=true).
blocking.fix: Set orch_parked_unreadable true in ALL_DEGRADED_SIGNALS and test an all-degraded snapshot with a queued resume and a qa-verdict event.

blocking.finding: ALL_DEGRADED_SIGNALS orch_parked_unreadable false makes a wholly degraded snapshot look like a healthy empty parked set to the auto-merge sweep, so a parked PR can be armed from a session qa-verdict event.
blocking.fix: Set it true (also json-snapshot.ts per-key degrade) and test all-degraded plus qa-verdict event expects a hold.

followUps.finding: The degraded fail-closed check sits inside 'if numbers:', so an absent needs_qa_numbers falls through to the fail-open boolean dispatch while orch_parked_unreadable is true.
Duplicated Code: the not _is_parked_anchor belt is hand-pasted at several dev.py sites plus the decide.py sweep.
followUps.fix: One helper in decide_base or filter once at pick extraction.

followUps.finding: Reason string parked:#N means issue number or PR number depending on branch.
orch_parked_unreadable duplicates the collector degraded marker and orch_parked_issues stays ambiguous for consumers ignoring the flag.
followUps.fix: Document the flag as mandatory alongside orch_parked_issues.

followUps.finding: The dirty/behind/unchecked skip uses parkedPrs, empty on an unreadable read, so those PR-gate arms stay open on degrade.
followUps.fix: Document as exempt from INV-4 or hold them when !parkedIssues.ok; add a test.

followUps.finding: parkedPrNumbers skips on ANY parked closing ref while INV-2 says ambiguous refs are never skipped; no test pins the choice.
followUps.fix: Amend INV-2 or require all refs parked; add a multi-ref test.

followUps.finding: Bucket 4 overstates that every arm skips parked PRs given the degraded-read gaps.
followUps.fix: Soften or fix the mediums first.
